NSCameraUsageDescription: SafaRoll uses the camera to photograph the animals you meet.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SafaRoll listens locally for nearby wildlife sounds when you enable Wild Listening.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SafaRoll opens your photo library only when you choose to import a picture.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: SafaRoll saves an image to your Photos when you ask it to.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SafaRoll records where each capture was made, to place it on your world map. You can continue without: identification does not change.
